notes: Tap a character's picture at the top of a chat and a card slides up from the bottom over the conversation, the way WhatsApp's contact card does. Their photo big at the top, their name and tagline, and chips for the things you would otherwise have to go hunting for — how old they are, who they are to the rest of the family, how much they remember about you, how many photos you have of them. Under that, a strip of their most recent photos and one-tap rows to the full set, their memories, and the full profile. In a group it lists everyone instead, and tapping a face swaps the card over to that person. Characters now have photo galleries. Add pictures from your device with the plus button, browse them as a grid, and tap any one to see it full size — where you can make it their profile picture or delete it. Pictures they send you in chat are now tappable too, and a character's photo can be kept straight into their gallery from there, which is the easiest way to build one up. Everything is stored on this device and shrunk on the way in, and the gallery shows how much room it is using so a full storage warning is not the first you hear of it. If a save is refused because storage is full, the photo is now taken back out rather than sitting on screen looking saved until the next reload loses it.
